lines.text: I'm Artifex. BR mod. Moderator Gate - this is where we evaluate whether you are ready for SEED.
It is not automatic. We look at overall activity, quality of what you posted, and how you treated other members.
What are you looking for exactly?
Genuine. Someone who came to contribute, not just farm points.
I always watch the logs. Every interaction. The SEED application is a filter - it passes people who built real presence.
You have Engage Points. Now comes the part points cannot cover. One question.

choices.label: I want to contribute for real. I learned a lot and want to pass it forward.
I want the benefits and the path toward Sprout.
I need the role for more visibility.
